April 21, 1981 
Salut & Tous! 


The gang downtown (Dave, Nancy and Dave) are busy helping Olga to prepare. 
for Ks. *S!. tots of phong, interviewing and planning is belng done and 
we are always finding more to do. 


IMPORTANT 


if any of you are Interested in K.K. ‘81 and we haven't heard from you, 
DON'T DELAY!! 


Interviews are In full swing, so if summer in St. Sauveur appeals to. you 
give us a call or drop in soon. 


DAVE'S DIRT 


Some events that are happening in the next while: 


1. Kamper Reunion at Westmount Y on May 2. You should have heard 
of this by now. All are welcome of course, and hope to see 
you there. 


Staff Reunlon/Get-together is tentatively planned for May 30/31 
in St. Sauveur. The particulars have not been worked out yet, 
but it will involve Saturday afternoon to Sunday afternoon. 


A minimal cost will be Involved (around $5.00 to $10.00). 
Let us know if you are interested so we can "guestimate' 
the number of people for planning purposes. Alt '80 and 
'81 staff to be Invited.
